description: Image Description: The image shows a decorative wall clock display mounted on a white textured wall. The display is hexagonal and framed with a colorful, patterned border. It contains five small round clocks, each labeled with a different country: "Germany," "Ghana," "Uganda," and "USA." The clocks show different times, suggesting world time zones. In the center of the hexagon is a plaque with the words "Cicero Guest House" and "Home Away From Home" written
